description.en: One shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, WSL or Niubash on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具，可在 Windows 上通过 PowerShell / Git Bash / MSYS2 / WSL / Niubash 执行命令；另提供底部工作台的内嵌终端，支持按 shell 激活开关与默认 shell 回落链。
description.pt: Uma ferramenta shell que executa comandos no Windows via PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, WSL ou Niubash, mais um terminal embutido no painel inferior com chaves de ativação por shell e cadeia de fallback do shell padrão.
